parso mummy ka birthday hai, cake order karna hai. kya suggest karoge?
6:14 PM

Parso Wed 28 Oct hai, toh cake ek din pehle, Tue 27 Oct tak order kar do, taaki time pe mil jaye. Kuch achhe options:

Chocolate truffle: Sabko pasand aata hai, galti ki gunjaish kam.
Rasmalai cake: Desi twist, mummy ke liye special lagta hai.
Fresh fruit cake: Halka hai, agar mummy ko meetha kam pasand hai.
Butterscotch ya pineapple: Purana classic, hamesha chalta hai.

Mummy ko kaunsa flavour sabse zyada pasand hai? Fir main options dhoondh deta hoon.
